content.text: {"explanations":[{"signal_id":"e81e6917-291c-4010-94c1-9345847a8fea","explanation":"Dataflake has about {{fact:78f6ae81-0bfe-4964-bff9-c570772de4ee}} months of cash at current burn, which limits its ability to absorb setbacks before it needs new funding. The low-severity runway covenant signal shows this has been shrinking quickly. The cash covenant signals show the same pressure on its balance sheet."},{"signal_id":"6158b663-e3e6-4a9b-bcee-a150197e9b9b","explanation":"Unrestricted cash of {{fact:c6b23fca-d829-47de-afb9-2c23d0a23106}} is below the {{fact:dfe07fca-0fbc-40ee-b40b-3a228a34e2f2}} minimum, giving headroom of {{fact:4485e2b5-96b8-4ad6-ba54-6343194e8b1c}}. That means the level is past the threshold, not merely close to it, though the signal is rated medium. It is the balance-sheet side of the short runway."},{"signal_id":"69403e17-e82f-48bb-b217-125d73c97e7d","explanation":"Runway covenant headroom fell from {{fact:0ac55194-1dd2-43ef-8b72-a1df0510d927}} in August to {{fact:3caa60a2-0f31-4409-a26f-9fb416c6117f}} in September and {{fact:09bff13b-0bba-432a-8f89-e9c4a43c04b8}} in October. Runway of {{fact:88465eb6-1917-4cd2-b16b-08d16b705fd9}} months remains above the {{fact:629bd59a-680f-43d2-9cd0-1e4063fb047e}}-month floor, but at this pace the cushion is thin. This is the trend behind the high-severity runway signal."},{"signal_id":"15d98b50-693f-4b05-bfa3-c33fd0f34931","explanation":"Cash covenant headroom moved from {{fact:c62ed519-9cd5-4290-86ff-3a880e7c459e}} in August to {{fact:34304bd5-0c7c-4ff3-a214-d8e31aa6b48b}} in September, then to {{fact:4485e2b5-96b8-4ad6-ba54-6343194e8b1c}} in October. The steady decline crossed below the minimum. This shows the medium-severity cash signal reflects ongoing burn, not a one-month dip."}],"ranking":["e81e6917-291c-4010-94c1-9345847a8fea","6158b663-e3e6-4a9b-bcee-a150197e9b9b","15d98b50-693f-4b05-bfa3-c33fd0f34931","69403e17-e82f-48bb-b217-125d73c97e7d"]}
